title: A House of Pomegranates
author: Oscar Wilde
description: "A House of Pomegranates" by Oscar Wilde is a collection of fairy tales published in 1891.
longDescription: This second fairy tale collection presents four stories exploring beauty, cruelty, love, and sacrifice.

authorInfo.bio: Oscar Wilde was an Irish writer celebrated for his wit, fairy tales and plays. The Picture of Dorian Gray is his only novel. His other works include The Importance of Being Earnest, The Happy Prince and The Ballad of Reading Gaol, spanning comedy, beauty and painful reflection.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source edition with preface and twenty chapters. Cover reproduced from the Project Gutenberg source EPUB.

rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.

rightsReview.policy: US public-domain source; all listed creative contributors died by 1900. Unknown dates excluded. Edition screening, not legal certification.

editionCredits: Transcribed from the 1915 Methuen and Co. edition by David Price
